svg.aria-label: A grid of 100 squares split between 5 parts: Adult Social Care 0, Housing Services (GFRA only) 30, Cultural and Related Services 15, Environmental and Regulatory Services 25, Central Services 30. Adult Social Care is under half a square and not drawn.
